title: Which village has the most tractors?
description: A pictograph shows the tractors in five villages, with one symbol for one tractor. Counting the symbols in each row gives the smallest and the greatest number, the difference between two villages, and whether one village has half of another.
teaching_notes: One idea: read a pictograph by counting the symbols in each row, using the key. Watch for students who compare the lengths of rows without counting, or who read the difference as a sum.

video_script.why: The child reads a pictograph with the key one symbol for one tractor, and answers four questions from the counts of its rows.
video_script.substitution: The tractors in five villages are read from the symbols of a pictograph.
video_script.anchor: a pictograph of the tractors in five villages, with one symbol for one tractor
video_script.payoff_line: Village D has the fewest tractors, Village C has the most, and the child is right

final_answer.value: a. Village D; b. Village C; c. 3; d. Yes
final_answer.spoken: village D has the fewest tractors, village C has the most, and the child is right

maths_rules: symbols in each row: Village A 6, Village B 5, Village C 8, Village D 3, Village E 6
smallest is Village D with 3 tractors, greatest is Village C with 8 tractors
Village C has 8 - 5 = 3 more tractors than Village B
half of 6 is 3, and Village D has 3, so Village D has half the tractors of Village E
video_script.design: The pictograph of the book is read row by row using its key. Each question is answered from the counted symbols, and two answers are checked by adding back.
